flow_name: European CRM to Third-Country Telemetry Streaming Ingestion

destination_system.importer_jurisdiction: United States (Third country without general adequacy decision)

eu_us_dpf_status.notes: Entity not listed in US Department of Commerce Data Privacy Framework participant list

pii_categories: Direct Identifiers (full customer name, unhashed email address)
Network Identifiers (source IPv4/IPv6, MAC address hash, TCP port)
Device Telemetry (Browser user-agent, hardware canvas fingerprint, OS build)
Precise Geolocation (GPS latitude/longitude extracted from mobile checkout)
Financial Transaction Metadata (transaction amount, payment method token, card brand, currency, decline error codes)
Behavioral Session URLs (full deep links to session recording replay containing form input coordinates)

device.user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 18_0 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15

legal_transfer_basis_governance.internal_justification_note: Considered internal technical telemetry for performance monitoring; no formal legal instrument executed by procurement or legal teams

standard_contractual_clauses_scc.notes: Vendor standard click-through terms accepted without European SCCs (Decision 2021/914/EU Module 2)

legal_transfer_basis_governance.derogation_claimed: None formally invoked. Informal claim of 'legitimate interest' or 'execution of service' by DevOps team (invalid under A.1.5.2 for structural mass transfers)

geographic_transparency_and_records.privacy_notice_wording: Information is securely processed using standard cloud partners and industry telemetry
geographic_transparency_and_records.transparency_gap: Destination countries (USA, India) and third-party importer (OmniTelemetry Inc.) not identified to PII principals

authentication.mechanism: Static API Token in Query Parameter

payload_security.pii_cleartext_status: All customer PII fields transmitted in plain unencrypted JSON payload

cryptographic_key_custody.safeguard_deficiency: Keys are held in destination country under foreign surveillance jurisdiction; zero technical mitigation against US CLOUD Act or FISA 702

records.data_categories: Customer credentials, direct PII, IP addresses, geolocation, financial events, session replay
records.purpose: Real-time user behavior telemetry and application analytics ingestion
